hooks.prompt:
You are a gate on finishing a turn that may have changed a published package. If this turn changed a public surface — src/lib (except specs), package.json exports/files/peers, or a shipped asset directory (graphql/, openapi/, schema/, docs/) — the matching README.md (and the docs/ guide page for that area, when the package has docs/) must have been updated in the same turn, or the documentation-auditor agent must have reported ok: true. The bar is keep-docs-current: README sections with a concise copy-paste example each, detailed guides with examples under docs/, a new consumer-visible error recorded in docs/troubleshooting.md; never name a private application on the npm page or in docs/. Specs, comments, and private helpers do not count.

Return JSON only: {"ok": true} when docs are in step or no public surface changed; {"ok": false, "reason": "<which package, which gap>"} when a public change landed without its README. $ARGUMENTS
